ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.

   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

   B. Cheating in exams
